changeChair(address).details: chair address should be set to the address of L1 VeloFarmerMessenger if it is being used

params.newChair_: L1 address to be set as chair

params.guardian_: L1 address to be set as guardian

params.newL2Chair_: L2 address to be set as l2chair

changeOptiFed(address).details: optiFed is the L1 address that receives all bridged DOLA/USDC from both withdrawToL1OptiFed functions

params.newOptiFed_: L1 address to be set as optiFed

params.newTreasury_: L2 address to be set as treasury

params.dolaAmount: Amount of DOLA to be added as liquidity in Velodrome DOLA/USDC pool
params.usdcAmount: Amount of USDC to be added as liquidity in Velodrome DOLA/USDC pool

params.newMaxSlippageBps: The new maximum allowed loss for DOLA -> USDC swaps. 1 = 0.01%
The new maximum allowed loss for adding/removing liquidity from DOLA/USDC pool. 1 = 0.01%
The new maximum allowed loss for USDC -> DOLA swaps. 1 = 0.01%

setPendingGov(address).details: `pendingGov` will have to call `claimGov` to complete `gov` transfer`pendingGov` should be an L1 address

params.newPendingGov_: L1 address to be set as `pendingGov`

params.dolaAmount: Amount of DOLA to swap to USDC

params.usdcAmount: Amount of USDC to swap to DOLA

withdrawLiquidity(uint256).details: If attempting to remove more DOLA than total LP tokens are worth, will remove all LP tokens.

params.dolaAmount: Desired dola value to remove from DOLA/USDC pool. Will attempt to remove 50/50 while allowing for `maxSlippageBpsLiquidity` bps of variance.

returns._0: Amount of USDC received from liquidity removal. Used by withdrawLiquidityAndSwap wrapper.

params.dolaAmount: Desired dola value to remove from DOLA/USDC pool. Will attempt to remove 50/50 while allowing for `maxSlippageBpsLiquidity` bps of variance.
Amount of DOLA to withdraw and send to L1 OptiFed
Amount of DOLA to withdraw and send to L1 OptiFed
params.usdcAmount: Amount of USDC to withdraw and send to L1 OptiFed

params.amount: Amount of the L2 token to be withdrawn
params.l2Token: Address of the L2 token to be withdrawn
params.to: L1 Address that tokens will be sent to

changeChair(address).notice: Method for gov to change the chair

changeGuardian(address).notice: Method for gov to change the guardian

changeL2Chair(address).notice: Method for gov to change the L2 chair

changeOptiFed(address).notice: Method for gov to change the L1 optiFed address

changeTreasury(address).notice: Method for gov to change treasury address, the address that receives all rewards

claimVeloRewards().notice: Claims all VELO token rewards accrued by this contract & transfer all VELO owned by this contract to `treasury`

deposit(uint256,uint256).notice: Attempts to deposit `dolaAmount` of DOLA & `usdcAmount` of USDC into Velodrome DOLA/USDC stable pool. Then, deposits LP tokens into gauge.

depositAll().notice: Calls `deposit()` with entire DOLA & USDC token balance of this contract.

resign().notice: Method for current chair of the fed to resign

setMaxSlippageDolaToUsdc(uint256).notice: Governance only function for setting acceptable slippage when swapping DOLA -> USDC

setMaxSlippageLiquidity(uint256).notice: Governance only function for setting acceptable slippage when adding or removing liquidty from DOLA/USDC pool

setMaxSlippageUsdcToDola(uint256).notice: Governance only function for setting acceptable slippage when swapping USDC -> DOLA

swapDOLAtoUSDC(uint256).notice: Swap `dolaAmount` of DOLA to USDC through velodrome.

swapUSDCtoDOLA(uint256).notice: Swap `usdcAmount` of USDC to DOLA through velodrome.

withdrawLiquidity(uint256).notice: Withdraws `dolaAmount` worth of LP tokens from gauge. Then, redeems LP tokens for DOLA/USDC.

withdrawLiquidityAndSwapToDOLA(uint256).notice: Withdraws `dolaAmount` worth of LP tokens from gauge. Then, redeems LP tokens for DOLA/USDC and swaps redeemed USDC to DOLA.

withdrawToL1OptiFed(uint256).notice: Withdraws `dolaAmount` of DOLA to optiFed on L1. Will take 7 days before withdraw is claimable on L1.

withdrawToL1OptiFed(uint256,uint256).notice: Withdraws `dolaAmount` of DOLA & `usdcAmount` of USDC to optiFed on L1. Will take 7 days before withdraw is claimable on L1.

withdrawTokensToL1(address,address,uint2.notice: Withdraws `amount` of `l2Token` to address `to` on L1. Will take 7 days before withdraw is claimable.
